caption:
AI summaries can miss or twist details. 🤔 Make it show its proof.

Paste this: "Summarize this in 5 bullets. Quote the exact line that supports each one."

Then check the quotes against your text. 📌 Save this prompt.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.
